usage: Used to describe the color green; it often comes before a noun, like a color adjective.
Very common in everyday speech and simple descriptions of plants, clothes, objects, and signs.
As a noun, it can refer to the color green, especially in set phrases or when talking about color categories.
For beginner learners, this word is simple and high-frequency; pair it with color words like 紅, 藍, 黃 for easy comparison.
